title: Grade 2 Science — Mon, Jun 16
description: Our Food — Day 1 of 5: Food from plants
subject: science

questions.question: Rice, wheat, and maize are examples of:
questions.explanation: Rice, wheat, and maize are grains (cereals). They are seeds of grass plants and are our main source of carbohydrates.

questions.question: Which of these is a fruit?
questions.explanation: A mango is a fruit — it grows from the flower of a mango tree and contains seeds inside.

questions.question: Which of these is a vegetable (root)?
questions.explanation: A carrot is the root of the carrot plant. We eat the underground root.

questions.question: Dal (lentils) comes from:
questions.explanation: Dal comes from pulse plants (legumes) like moong, masoor, and chana. We eat their dried seeds.

questions.question: Which part of the plant do we eat when we eat rice?
questions.explanation: Rice is the seed of the rice plant. We eat seeds when we eat rice, wheat, maize, and dal.

questions.question: Mustard oil and coconut oil are made from:
questions.explanation: Mustard oil comes from mustard seeds and coconut oil from coconuts. Many cooking oils come from plant seeds.

questions.question: Spinach and cabbage are examples of:
questions.explanation: Spinach (palak) and cabbage are leafy vegetables — we eat the leaves of the plant.

questions.question: Sugar comes from which plant?
questions.explanation: Sugar is made from the sweet juice extracted from sugarcane stems.

questions.question: Groundnuts (peanuts) are seeds we eat. They grow ___.
questions.explanation: Groundnuts are legumes that produce their pods underground. The nuts (seeds) are found below the soil.

questions.question: Which of these gives us food from its flower?
questions.explanation: Cauliflower and broccoli are flowers of their plants that we eat as vegetables.

questions.question: Turmeric and ginger that we use in cooking are:
questions.explanation: Turmeric and ginger are underground stems (rhizomes) of plants. They are used as spices.

questions.question: Fruits grow from ___.
questions.explanation: Fruits develop from the flowers of a plant after pollination. They contain the seeds of the plant.

questions.question: Which of these is a pulse (dal)?
questions.explanation: Chana (chickpea) is a pulse — a protein-rich seed of a legume plant. Other pulses: moong, masoor, urad.

questions.question: Tea leaves are used to make tea. We get them from:
options: The roots of the tea tree
The leaves of the tea plant
The flowers of the tea plant
The seeds of the tea plant
questions.explanation: Tea is made from the dried leaves of the tea plant (Camellia sinensis).

questions.question: Which of these foods does NOT come from a plant?
questions.explanation: Eggs come from hens (animals), not plants. Mango juice (fruit), bread (wheat grain), and rice are all from plants.
